info.title: API.SH: TennisExplorer
info.description: The TennisExplorer API from API.SH: public TennisExplorer data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

tags.name: Account
tags.description: Your balance, usage, logs and past responses. Free.

get.summary: Balance, plan, spend and spend limits
get.description: Credits by bucket (free monthly, plan, pay-as-you-go), the plan, credits spent today and this month (UTC), your spend limits and the key used. Free: costs no credits.

401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

get.description: Calls, errors and credits per UTC day, and the top endpoints by credits. Free. Add output=csv for the daily rows as CSV.

401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

get.summary: Your calls of the last 30 days
get.description: Newest first. Filter by status, route prefix, key or time; page with `before` (the `next` value). Add output=csv|ndjson to download (up to 5,000 rows per request; the next cursor is in the x-next-cursor header). Free.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: ok, error, or an HTTP status like 502.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Only calls made with this key id.

401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

get.summary: Fetch a past response again, free
get.description: The exact response a call returned, for 30 days after the call, at no cost. Use the call's x-request-id. Supports output=csv|ndjson.

200.description: The stored response (headers: x-refetch: 1, x-original-time, x-original-route).

404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

get.summary: Tennis match: players, score, head to head and odds
get.description:
One match: date, time, tournament, round and surface, both players (ranking, birth date, height, weight, plays), result and set scores, head to head with every past meeting, and each bookmaker's current and opening home/away odds.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/tennisexplorer-match

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Match id from /tennisexplorer/v1/matches, or a tennisexplorer.com/match-detail/?id= link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: Tennis matches and results by day
get.description:
Every match of a day by tournament: time, players with seeds and ids, sets won, set scores, odds and match id. All tours (default) or ATP or WTA singles or doubles.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/tennisexplorer-matches

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: Tennis player profile, record and season matches
get.description:
A tennis player: country, height, weight, age and birth date, current and highest singles and doubles rank, plays, photo, win/loss by year and surface, the season's singles matches (tournament, surface, opponent, round, score, odds, match id) and injuries.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/tennisexplorer-player

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Player id from search or rankings (sinner-8b8e8), or a tennisexplorer.com/player link.

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: Season for the match list (default the current one).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: ATP and WTA rankings (singles, doubles, race)
get.description:
ATP or WTA ranking, 50 players a page: rank, movement, player, player id, country and points. Singles, doubles or the race; any past ranking week (`dates[]` lists them); one country. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/tennisexplorer-rankings

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Players (id, name, country, sex) or tournaments (id, slug, name) matching a name.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/tennisexplorer-search

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: Tennis tournament results and next matches
get.description:
A tournament edition: name, prize money, surface, category, next matches with odds, results (round, players, sets, odds, match id) and the years it was held. Singles or doubles, main draw or qualification.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/tennisexplorer-tournament

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: Tournament slug (paris, wimbledon, us-open) from search, or a tennisexplorer.com/<slug>/<year>/<tour>/ link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
